level-1-trailhead.alt: Level 1, Trailhead: a single trailhead post carrying one blaze on otherwise empty ground - the route has not started yet.

level-2-greenhorn.alt: Level 2, Greenhorn: the trailhead post with the first blazed trail segment leaving it toward a marker not yet reached.

level-3-pathfinder.alt: Level 3, Pathfinder: a blazed post standing at a fork, one branch chosen and blazed while the other fades away unmarked - the route is now a decision.

level-4-trailhand.alt: Level 4, Trailhand: a worked trail carrying three blazes across two contour terraces - the ground itself has become legible, not just the path.

level-5-ridge-runner.alt: Level 5, Ridge Runner: a ridge profile stacked in front of a back range, with the blazed trail running the whole spine from the low ground to the peak.

level-6-wayfinder.alt: Level 6, Wayfinder: a graduated eight-point compass card set on a nested contour field - this rider reads both the ground and the bearing.

level-7-trail-boss.alt: Level 7, Trail Boss: three ranges deep with a foreground bench, the blazed climb reaching a summit marker at the top - the fullest emblem in the ladder.

artifact-risk-profile.alt: Risk profile artifact: a ruled notebook page holding four honest entries about your own riding, the second marked with a trail blaze as the leak most likely to catch you.

artifact-inspection-log.alt: Inspection log artifact: five T-CLOC zone rows walked top to bottom in fixed order, four zones ticked and the fifth still open with the marker sitting against it.

artifact-gear-card.alt: Gear card artifact: a pocket card laid on the ruled page carrying the five every-ride items head to toe - full-face helmet, eye protection, long sleeves, gloves, over-ankle boots - with the helmet blazed as the non-negotiable.

artifact-hazard-brief.alt: Hazard brief artifact: three hazards written up on the ruled page, each filed under the cue that gives it away - a crest, shadowed ruts, a wet band - with the rut cue blazed as the one that decides the line.

artifact-readiness-plan.alt: Readiness plan artifact: the three things that make a ride recoverable - who you told, the return time you committed to, and the kit list leaving with you - with the clock hand blazed on the time.

artifact-ride-plan.alt: Ride plan artifact: the capstone. A full folded plan sheet, larger and more complete than any other artifact page, with six worked sections above the fold, a ruled summary strip below, and the trail blaze sealing it.

xp-step-complete.alt: One trail blaze: a step completed.

xp-lesson-complete.alt: A trail blaze inside a closed ring: a whole lesson finished.

xp-checkpoint-first-try.alt: A checkpoint pennant marked clean: the checkpoint passed on the first try.

xp-module-complete.alt: The badge frame, a blaze diamond earned: a module completed.

xp-journal-artifact.alt: A written notebook page: a journal artifact completed.

xp-scenario-best-path.alt: A fork with the better line taken and blazed: the best path found in a scenario.

xp-lab-objectives.alt: Three objectives ticked off: every lab objective met.

xp-capstone.alt: The ride-plan sheet folded into three panels: the capstone completed.

xp-final-assessment.alt: A summit marker standing over the range: the final assessment passed.

xp-tutor-first.alt: Ranger's campaign hat: the first question asked of the tutor.

empty-progress.alt: A trail odometer standing at zero, every counter drum still blank, with a blazed trail rising away beside it - no miles recorded yet, and the first one waiting.

empty-instructor.alt: A trailhead register box open on its post, the ruled columns of the ledger still blank and the pencil hanging unused - no learner has signed in yet.

state-403.alt: A staff-only service spur closed by a striped warden barrier beside the warden's post, while the learner's own blazed trail carries on open to the left - this route belongs to someone else, not to you later.

hero-assessment.alt: The final ridge: a blazed trail climbing its shouldered face with the summit marker already in sight ahead - everything the course taught, still to be walked.

hero-graduate.alt: The summit reached: the whole range the course crossed spread out below, the climbed trail running back down to the right, and one blaze planted at the top beside the cairn.
